title: Point of View & Voice
summary: Explore first person, third person limited and omniscient, and find a voice that sounds like a real narrator.
bigIdeas: Who tells the story changes the story.
A narrator can only know what their point of view allows.
Voice is personality on the page.
Tone comes from the words you choose.

projectSpec.title: My Narrator's Story
projectSpec.description: Write a short story (600–900 words) with a narrator who has a strong voice. Choose first person, third person limited or omniscient on purpose and keep it steady, set a tone and let your word choices create it, and include one scene retold from a different character's point of view.
